objective: Use the existing local runner and GitHub-sync loop to decide the safe next PMTiles path after latest_local_probe: verify whether Docker can run a containerized geospatial toolchain and whether missing region source assets are available anywhere locally. Do not write DB, do not deploy, do not generate fake data.
checks: Read current bridge heartbeat/current-task/.last-task-id and queue state.
Verify Docker availability with docker version and docker image list, without pulling large images unless already cached.
Search local repo for existing Dockerfile, docker compose service, or scripts that include tippecanoe, pmtiles, ogr2ogr, gdal, or build_pmtiles_from_hf_parquet.py.

Search local filesystem under repo for existing source assets: parcels_source.gpkg, parcels_prepared.parquet, parcels_prepared_simplified.parquet, .mbtiles, .pmtiles for london, south_east, south_west, midlands, north, wales, scotland.
Do not download protected remote data. If a remote URL needs auth/token, report BLOCKED_TOKEN_REQUIRED.
Write a concise TXT and JSON result to docs/chatgpt_status/runner_outputs on branch chatgpt-local-sync.
decision_rules: If cached Docker/toolchain image exists and source parquet/gpkg exists, next task may be PMTiles generation dry-run for one missing region only.
If tools exist but source assets missing, next task must be source acquisition/token/access plan, not generation.
If neither tools nor source assets exist, next task must be toolchain bootstrap plan plus source acquisition plan.
If East PMTiles exists only, keep final classification as partial coverage until all configured regions pass.
chatgpt_next_step: On next devam, read the new runner output from GitHub, classify whether the blocker is toolchain-only, source-only, token/access, or both, then queue the next single safe task.
